WoW: Forever

Restoration Shaman

Triage healing — a big wave, a fast wave, or a chain heal across a cluster, now with an instant repeatable heal over time. The published ratings put it highest of the three Shaman specs overall, at 4.0, and lowest for levelling, at 2.0.

WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Restoration build has been tested. Chain HealChain HealLevel 40 · Spell · NatureCast2.5 sec castCost260 ManaRange40 yd range is level 40, so the spec's signature spell does not exist at any beta cap. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended.

What Restoration is for

Group triage: Chain HealChain HealLevel 40 · Spell · NatureCast2.5 sec castCost260 ManaRange40 yd range across a cluster, and Nature's SwiftnessNature's SwiftnessTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration-0.001 secWhen activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell. at exactly 30 to make your next Nature spell instant — in practice a Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · NatureCast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 39. you cannot be interrupted out of. Chain HealChain HealLevel 40 · Spell · NatureCast2.5 sec castCost260 ManaRange40 yd range is level 40, so until then the group-facing tools are Mana Tide TotemMana Tide TotemLevel 40 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost10 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration13 sec at 25 and Water ShieldWater ShieldLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCastInstantCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration600 sec at exactly 20, which returns 2% of your maximum mana each time you are hit or crit a heal.

Slow to solo, strong in a group. The rating only measures the first. The published heading is "Healer Leveling": "As a Healer specialization, Restoration lacks most of the damage talent support of other classes and has no area damage, making it more of a group leveling specialization." Ratings: Overall 4.0, Levelling 2.0.

Dungeons are what it is for: "Restoration will make you a strong dungeon healer."

One major source's own advice is to level Enhancement and respec when you want to heal — its level-20 recommendation for every Shaman is the Enhancement build (see below) — or level in groups from the start. Soloing as Restoration means playing a worse Elemental Shaman: "you will mostly use Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · NatureCast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 14 Nature damage. and Flame ShockFlame ShockLevel 10 · Spell · FireCastInstantCost55 ManaRange20 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration12 sec… as if you were Elemental, with the downside of having no extra damage from talents."

Healing priority

  1. Pre-place your totems, Searing TotemSearing TotemLevel 10 · Spell · FireCastInstantCost25 ManaDuration30 sec last
  2. Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · NatureCast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 39. on injured targets
  3. Lesser Healing WaveLesser Healing WaveLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCast1.5 sec castCost105 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 153. when you need the cast to land faster
  4. Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · NatureCast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 14 Nature damage. as filler when nothing needs healing

From 30: Nature's SwiftnessNature's SwiftnessTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration-0.001 secWhen activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell. into Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · NatureCast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 39. as your emergency button, and Mana Tide TotemMana Tide TotemLevel 40 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost10 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration13 sec for the group's mana.

Multi-target: there is none. Chain HealChain HealLevel 40 · Spell · NatureCast2.5 sec castCost260 ManaRange40 yd range is level 40, so there is no group heal in this beta at any cap. Fire NovaFire NovaLevel 12 · Spell · FireCastInstantCost95 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldown is your only area damage, and it needs an active Fire totem.

Stat priority

Healing Power, then critical strike, Haste, Intellect, MP5, Spirit, Stamina.

Sources genuinely disagree about critical strike here: one puts it second, another puts it last (Healing Power > Intellect > MP5 > Spirit > Haste > crit), and nothing resolves it. A third phrases the top of the list as "Healing and spell power above everything, then Intellect… and Spirit for what comes back between fights."

Healing bonus on gear now also grants one third as much spell damage, which makes filler Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · NatureCast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 14 Nature damage.s less wasteful than they used to be.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools.
